title: Listening practice
subtitle: A2 · Unit 4: Tell a clear story

steps.title: Listen once
steps.body: In the real test you hear each recording once. Tap the speaker, listen, then choose. Do not replay. Never leave a question empty.

steps.fr: À cette époque, le centre était paisible le matin et la rue était calme.
steps.question: How was the centre in the morning?
steps.explain: The speaker describes it as paisible, quiet.

steps.fr: Chaque mardi, nous prenions le bus après le travail et nous rentrions à dix-huit heures.
steps.question: When did the speakers use to take the bus?
steps.explain: The recording says chaque mardi and après le travail.

steps.fr: Il y avait une cour intérieure avec un banc près de l'entrée.
steps.question: What was near the entrance?
steps.explain: The recording mentions a bench near the entrance.

steps.fr: Pendant l'hiver, le ciel était souvent couvert, mais la pièce restait calme.
steps.question: What was often overcast?
steps.explain: The speaker says the sky was often overcast.

steps.fr: Le dimanche, ma tante préparait le repas pendant que nous parlions dans la cuisine.
steps.question: What did the aunt use to prepare on Sundays?
steps.explain: The recording says the aunt prepared the meal.
